map.输入室内甲醛、TVOC、苯等污染物浓度，按GB/T 18883标准判定室内空气质: Enter indoor formaldehyde, TVOC, benzene and other pollutant concentrations and judge whether indoor air quality meets the GB/T 18883 standard
map.📖 查看「环保（甲醛/检测）指标 使用指南」: 📖 View the User Guide for Environmental (Formaldehyde/Test) Indicators
map.按 GB/T 18883-2022 判定：甲醛 1 小时均值不超过 0.08 m: Per GB/T 18883-2022: 1-hour mean formaldehyde <= 0.08 mg/m³, benzene <= 0.03, toluene <= 0.20, xylene <= 0.20, 8-hour mean TVOC <= 0.60 (all in mg/m³); if any measured value exceeds its limit, that pollutant is over-standard and the overall result fails; sampling should be done after sealing for 12 hours; if over-standard, increase ventilation or use air purification.
map.新房入住前自测：录入甲醛、TVOC 实测值，与 GB/T 18883 限值（甲醛: Self-test before moving into a new home: enter measured formaldehyde and TVOC values, compare item by item with GB/T 18883 limits (formaldehyde 0.10, TVOC 0.60 mg/m³, etc.), output pass / over-standard and the exceedance multiple.
map.办公室通风评估：多次采样取均值后判定，结合通风时长给出改善建议（通风、活性炭、绿: Office ventilation assessment: judge after multiple samplings averaged, give improvement advice combined with ventilation duration (ventilation, activated carbon, plants, professional treatment).
map.复测对比：治理前后两次数据同屏对比，看浓度下降比例是否进入安全区间。: Re-test comparison: compare pre- and post-treatment data on the same screen to see whether the concentration drop enters the safe range.
map.示例：密闭 12h 后实测甲醛 0.14 mg/m³、TVOC 0.45 mg/: Example: after sealing 12 h, measured formaldehyde 0.14 mg/m³, TVOC 0.45 mg/m³.
map.限值按哪个标准？: Which standard are the limits based on?
map.本工具默认 GB/T 18883（人居室内），与 GB 50325（验收）限值不: This tool defaults to GB/T 18883 (occupied indoor); it differs from GB 50325 (acceptance), which is stricter; distinguish as needed.
map.采样前密闭时长、温度、湿度、通风历史都会显著影响结果，建议按标准条件采样。: Pre-sampling seal duration, temperature, humidity and ventilation history all significantly affect results; sample under standard conditions.
map.加强通风、控制污染源，必要时专业治理并复测；本工具仅作判定参考，不代表 CMA: Increase ventilation, control pollution sources, and if necessary use professional treatment and re-test; this tool is only a judgment reference and does not represent a CMA test report.
map.检测依据GB/T 18883-2022《室内空气质量标准》，需关闭门窗12小时后: Testing is based on GB/T 18883-2022 Indoor Air Quality Standard; sampling requires closing doors and windows for 12 hours
map.甲醛限值≤0.10mg/m³，TVOC≤0.60mg/m³，苯≤0.11mg/m: Formaldehyde limit <= 0.10 mg/m³, TVOC <= 0.60 mg/m³, benzene <= 0.11 mg/m³, ammonia <= 0.20 mg/m³, radon <= 300 Bq/m³
map.新装修房间建议通风3-6个月后再检测，检测前避免使用空气清新剂: Newly decorated rooms are advised to ventilate 3–6 months before testing; avoid air fresheners before testing
map.采样点应避开通风口，距墙壁不少于0.5m，高度0.8-1.5m: Sampling points should avoid vents, be at least 0.5 m from walls, and 0.8–1.5 m in height
map.本工具结果仅供参考，正式检测应由具备CMA资质的检测机构进行: This tool results are for reference only; formal testing should be done by a CMA-qualified testing institution
map.室内空气质量检测判定工具，输入甲醛、TVOC、苯、氨、氡等污染物浓度，按GB/T: An indoor air quality testing tool: enter formaldehyde, TVOC, benzene, ammonia, radon and other pollutant concentrations, judge against GB/T 18883 whether it passes, and give remediation advice.
